all-tools.name: All-in-One Dev Agent
all-tools.description: General-purpose development agent that carries the whole loop itself — understands an issue, designs an approach, implements and tests it, and opens a pull request for review — for when one capable agent suits better than a team of specialists.

code-agent.name: Code Agent
code-agent.description: Focused implementer that turns issue specifications into clean, tested, production-quality code on issue branches only — PR-first draft flow marked ready only on green CI, foreground CI polling, progress notes, and hard boundaries (never pushes to main, force-pushes, merges PRs, or reviews code).

copywriter-content.name: Copywriter Content
copywriter-content.description: Long-form content drafter that consumes a content brief (persona, topic, factual inputs, optional VOC data), binds to your team's voice anchor, and drafts hook-body-close prose — blog, Substack, video/podcast script, case-study, or LinkedIn longpost — under ban lists, a 12-point anti-AI-tell gate, and concrete-specificity mandate, delivered as an issue comment for human review with progress notes; strictly read-only — never writes repo files, pushes, commits, merges, or publishes, no short-form copy, no invented facts.

copywriter-marketing.name: Copywriter Marketing
copywriter-marketing.description: Short-form marketing & UX copy generator that consumes a copy assignment (brief, audience, format, constraints, optional VOC data), binds to your team's voice anchor, and generates N≥3 structurally distinct angle-labeled variants per deliverable — ads, microcopy, transactional email, landing hero/CTA — inside the platform character-constraint tables with inline counts, under ban lists, a 12-point anti-AI-tell gate, and concrete-specificity mandate, delivered as an issue comment for human review with progress notes; strictly read-only — never writes code or repo files, pushes, commits, merges, or publishes, and never attempts long-form.

crazy-ivan.name: Crazy Ivan
crazy-ivan.description: Exact-head adversarial auditor of the assigned PR before merge — audits both the code and the review that approved it, files evidence-grounded issues (file:line + quoted code, grouped intelligently), and posts an audit summary verdict pinned to the audited head SHA. Strictly read-only.

designer-agent.name: Designer Agent
designer-agent.description: Advisory UX reviewer for git-hosted projects that conducts a proxy experience for every user-facing change (CLI/API ergonomics, documentation clarity, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, visual design) and files prioritized `## Design Review` feedback as code-host comments — strictly read-only, never writes code, pushes, merges, or blocks; optionally generates design images with the configured image-generation model and attaches them to the issue.

devops-agent.name: DevOps Agent
devops-agent.description: Infrastructure provisioner that turns issues into host bootstrap scripts, PaaS docker-compose configs, code-host webhooks, and infra documentation on issue branches only — pattern-first, least-privilege, everything validated before push, and live infrastructure only ever WRITTEN, never executed, without explicit PM approval.

instructional-designer-agent.name: Instructional Designer Agent
instructional-designer-agent.description: Learning-experience designer for git-hosted projects that turns a curriculum issue (audience persona, session format, industry context, topic, duration) into Backward-Design structure — Mager ABCD Bloom's-tagged objectives, retrieval-practice cadence, worked-example sequences, Day 1/7/30 reinforcement — filed as issue comments with [FACILITATOR]/[VERIFY]/[HANDOFF] markers, never fabricating case studies or tool claims.

market-research-agent.name: Market Research Agent
market-research-agent.description: Read-only technology researcher for git-hosted projects — researches technology choices, evaluates vendors and services, and performs competitive analysis, delivering evidence-cited structured reports (Options Evaluated, Comparison Matrix, Recommendation, Implementation Considerations, Sources) as issue comments or standalone issues. Strictly read-only: never writes code, pushes, modifies files, merges, or makes purchasing decisions.

pm-agent.name: PM Agent
pm-agent.description: Interactive orchestrator of the development pipeline for git-hosted projects — creates issues with testable acceptance criteria, delegates implementation, review and design to agents, consumes progress notes and head-SHA-pinned verdicts, and is the only role that merges approved, AC-validated work.

qa-agent.name: QA Agent
qa-agent.description: Testing-posture owner that turns issue specifications into E2E, integration, and deployment-smoke test suites (or test-framework setup) on issue branches only — PR-first draft flow marked ready only on green CI, foreground CI polling, progress notes, and hard boundaries (never writes unit tests, fixes app bugs, reviews or merges PRs, pushes to main, or touches production data).

review-agent.name: Review Agent
review-agent.description: Read-only pull-request reviewer that posts machine-parseable APPROVED / REQUEST_CHANGES verdicts via the code-host API — evidence-grounded AC verdict table (real file:line + quoted code fence per row), head-SHA pinning, runner-based CI verification, and hard boundaries (never writes code, pushes, merges, modifies files, or approves without AC evidence).

reward-hack-auditor.name: Reward-Hack Auditor
reward-hack-auditor.description: Pre-merge adversarial gate that audits the entire PR surface — full commit history (not just the final tree), full diff, every PR comment, each reviewer verdict, every acceptance criterion — against a 7-signal reward-hack taxonomy and posts exactly one SHA-pinned CLEAN/DIRTY/PENDING verdict; strictly read-only and fail-closed.

security-agent.name: Security Agent
security-agent.description: Read-only proactive security auditor that performs deep-dive audits across entire repositories and infrastructure configurations — version fingerprints, secret scans (current tree + git history), dependency CVEs, OWASP Top 10 code review, infra-config and access-control review — and files evidence-grounded issues with severity, file:line, quoted evidence, and remediation, plus a full audit summary. It never writes code, pushes, merges, rotates credentials, or touches production.

user-research-agent.name: User Research Agent
user-research-agent.description: Proxy UX tester of live deployed applications — walks real user flows at the production URL (happy path, edge cases, error conditions, keyboard-only, narrow viewport), audits every surface against WCAG 2.1 AA, and files each distinct finding as a separate severity-rated issue plus a session-summary comment. Strictly read-only: never writes code, pushes, modifies files, merges, or reviews PR diffs.

video-creator.name: Video Creator
video-creator.description: Short-form video producer for git-hosted projects — consumes a video brief (script or topic), binds to your product's voice anchor, authors a scene-by-scene shot plan with one generation prompt per scene, generates per-scene clips plus optional TTS narration and stills/b-roll with the configured backends (never substituting one silently), assembles a single cut where the brief asks for one, and delivers drafts as an issue comment plus uploaded assets for human review with progress notes; strictly read-only — never writes repo files, pushes, commits, merges, or publishes.
